description: Pass a question or request to the owner when the fact sheet doesn't cover it (holiday pricing, discounts, contract/payment/cancellation terms, longer or shorter stays, special services, anything else). The guest's email is on file and used automatically.

context.description: Dates, party size and anything else relevant from the conversation

email.description: Guest's email for the owner's reply (defaults to the email the guest gave at the start)

kind.description: crew_question when the guest wants to ask Captain Rob or Chef Julia something (menus, diets, diving, itinerary ideas) — the owner forwards it to the crew; referral_lead for groups over 8 or 5-cabin/10-passenger requests

question.description: The guest's question or request, in full

requester.description: Optional: who this request is for, so the owner can follow up personally.

name: ask_owner
title: Ask the owner
